summary: AMASS In-App Chat Phase 1 validation. Backend: /app/backend/tests/test_chat_phase1.py 15/15 PASS against deployed URL (start-from-property + idempotency, self-chat blocked, outsider 403 on GET/send, client_msg_id de-dup, block prevents send both directions, report from participant, long-poll delivers within ~1s, empty text 422, non-existent property 404, admin stats/reports require admin, demo@amass.africa gets 200 with all 5 stat keys). Frontend E2E on mobile viewport 390x844: btn-contact-agent renders (48px touch target, 342px wide), tap navigates to /chat/<conversation_id>; chat-screen + chat-property-card (shows title 'E2E Chat Duplex', location, ₦250M) + chat-input + chat-send + chat-menu all present; optimistic outgoing bubble appears immediately with '· sent' status; long-poll delivers agent message within ~4s without refresh; overflow menu shows 'Report user or message' + 'Block user'; Report modal (report-reason + report-submit) opens, accepts input, submits and closes; /inbox renders inbox-screen with conv-<id> preview line '🏠 E2E Chat Duplex · ₦250M'; /messages tab alias renders inbox-screen (matches request). Phase-D regression: 133 passed / 1 skipped / 1 FAILED — the failure is test_phase_d1::TestIdempotentSeeding::test_no_startup_errors_in_backend_err_log because backend.err.log contains stale 'duplicate key error' entries from chat_msg_idempotency writes with client_msg_id=null before the partial-filter (partialFilterExpression: {client_msg_id: {$type: string}}) was added to the index. The current live index HAS the correct partial filter (verified via list_indexes), the current chat.py code is correct, and I confirmed no NEW duplicate-key errors are being produced (fresh insert of 2 null-client_msg_id docs succeeds). Log needs to be rotated / cleared OR a startup migration must drop and recreate the index while wiping the log to make this scanner pass. Deprecated packages / RN issues detected: none new for Phase 1 chat; pre-existing RN Web warnings (shadow*, pointerEvents prop) unchanged.

minor.issue: backend.err.log contains 7 stale 'E11000 duplicate key error' entries from chat_msg_idempotency (client_msg_id: null) written before the partial-filter was added to the index. Current index in Mongo is correct (partialFilterExpression on $type=string); no new errors observed. Blocks Phase-D log scanner test test_no_startup_errors_in_backend_err_log.

action_items: (Optional / log-hygiene) Rotate or truncate /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log and, on startup, drop-then-recreate chat_msg_idempotency so any pre-partial-filter version of the index is replaced. Consider adding a one-shot migration in chat.py's register_indexes: try/except drop_index('chat_msg_idempotency') before create_index — safe because index will be re-created immediately after. Without this the Phase-D 'no startup errors in log' scanner will keep flagging historical entries.
critical_code_review_comments: chat.py send_message correctly uses `if data.client_msg_id:` guard before the find_one dedupe check, so idempotency short-circuits BEFORE reaching the Mongo insert — the historical duplicate-key errors were only possible with the older (non-partial-filter) index shape. Current code + current index are consistent.
chat.py mark_read is correctly upsert-based and also flips related NEW_MESSAGE notifications to read — good UX coupling.
Long-poll endpoint uses tail-latest strategy with wait_ms cap (LONG_POLL_MAX_MS) — behaved well under load; test observed <2s propagation.
Frontend property/[id].tsx Contact Agent button correctly awaits chatStartFromProperty then router.push(`/chat/{id}`); shows Alert on failure — solid error handling.
inbox.tsx conv-<id> renders both agent-name and property preview line — matches spec.

When re-running the full backend suite, prefer serial execution or run test_chat_phase1.py before test_phase_d1_property_types_settings.py so the log scanner only sees a clean run (or clear the log first). rca_of_issue: RCA for the single Phase-D failure: backend.err.log persists across supervisor restarts. Historical chat_msg_idempotency writes recorded duplicate-key errors in the log when the code inserted messages with client_msg_id=None BEFORE the partial-filter was added to the unique index. Once the partialFilterExpression {client_msg_id:{$type:string}} was applied, null-valued documents stopped being indexed and stopped colliding — but the earlier log lines survive. Reproduction: `grep -c chat_msg_idempotency /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log` returns 7. Mitigation options: (a) rotate the log at deploy time; (b) add a defensive startup step to drop the old index shape before creating the new one, and truncate the log file if under our control.
